verdict.rationale: API parity is a fair question for a SaaS equity and fund platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents only UI workflows (navigate to Equity > Valuations, click Add, toggle settings) and no public API. Every probed OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404. HRIS integrations, OCF/Excel exports and an llms.txt docs index are adjacent features, not a programmatic API, so they earn no credit.
